title: Fletcher Avenue over I-65 / I-70 | proposed 2026 deck replacement
source_note: INDOT B-44576 proposed 2026 Fletcher deck/rail/bearing work over retained 1971-73 steel and substructure. Old I-65-112-5723 alias is matched by crossing, 2 x 147 ft spans, eight lines and identical skew. Construction completion is not established. Drawing download is a local review binder; original source files and page offsets are recorded in source_index.json.
assumptions: Exterior visualization reconstruction, not an as-built survey, load rating or validated FEM mesh.
No internal reinforcement, prestressing strands, embedded studs, weld beads or fabrication holes. Material colors are visualization choices.
Source pages mix historical removals and proposed work. Only the explicitly named design state is modeled; the separately stored later references do not alter that state.
Buried foundations are hidden by default. Unknown driven pile lengths, terrain and approach-road terminal systems are omitted.
Bearing contact checks verify constructed geometric attachment only; they do not establish surveyed bearing elevations or fabrication tolerances.
Historical station numbers and proposed roadway grades differ. Nominal reconstructed girder/seat interfaces fit the proposed grade; fabrication camber and exact retained elevations are unresolved.
The local origin is near Pier 2; vertical zero uses the old pier-footing bottom as a display datum. No surveyed geographic placement.
Source review binder also contains Virginia Avenue and traffic/site sheets; those structures are not part of this GLB.

detail_coverage.detail: Eight retained haunched plate-girder lines, both spans, skew deck, two walks, 24 bearing envelopes and all three supports. Girders numbered 1 (south, +Y) to 8 (north, -Y) as on S8; Pier 2 seat steps per S7.

Support haunches, field splices, splice bolts, selected stiffeners and bracing. Exact plate schedule, curved haunch radii, camber, gussets and shoe assemblies remain incomplete. Web 5/8 in; 80 in web at Pier 2 on the S10 typical haunch; S9/S10 pier flanges. Field splices per S9/S10: webs aligned, 1 in / 1/2 in fillers and 26 in x 7/8 in / 24 in x 1 in splice plates; girder ends 4 1/2 in beyond the abutment bearings. Splice web plates 19 in x 5/8 in x 4 ft 6 in with 108 web bolts, 10 in x 1 in inner splice bars and four-line flange bolt patterns per S9/S10; bottom lateral bracing on the S11 gusset level.

North (-Y) 3 ft 6 in TX rail and south (+Y) 4 ft 6 in modified TX rail with the 1 ft taller base, 360 actual window openings, walks 1.5 % above an 8 in curb on a 2 % deck. Molded window splays and recesses remain simplified. Four modified TTX railing transitions (Wings A-D, sheets 68/69) on the approach-slab extensions, six windows each; face recesses simplified.

Both skew-to-square approach slabs, 66 ft 2 in wide with a 54 ft 2 in long edge at the coping line (sheet 66), their walks, the four 1 ft 2 in RCBA slab extensions with the sidewalk over them (Wing B also beyond the square end) and four drain envelopes. Drain routing, slab penetrations, terminal joints, roadside terminals and traffic equipment are not reconstructed.
Exact field bearing/shim elevations, wing splay, fabrication holes, rail moldings, TTX face recesses and notches, complete drainage, utility fittings and site surfaces.

known_deviations.deviation: Envelopes run from the S7 seat steps to the girder bottoms. Modelled / drawn stack (S12 shoe ES-1/ES-2 1 ft 6 in, ES-3 1 ft 4 in, plus the S13 Pier 2 shim): B2_bearing_1 (girder 8) 0.418 / 0.470 m, B2_bearing_2 (girder 7) 0.429 / 0.470 m, B2_bearing_3 (girder 6) 0.389 / 0.424 m, B2_bearing_4 (girder 5) 0.404 / 0.424 m, B2_bearing_5 (girder 4) 0.415 / 0.435 m, B2_bearing_6 (girder 3) 0.385 / 0.419 m, B2_bearing_7 (girder 2) 0.430 / 0.470 m, B2_bearing_8 (girder 1) 0.410 / 0.479 m; every envelope is 19-70 mm short.
known_deviations.reason: The stack itself is drawn: sheet 56 keeps the Pier 2 shoes, S12 gives the shoe heights and S13 the shims. Closing it means raising the girders at Pier 2 by the shortfall, and the plans do not give the 2026 girder elevations that would allow that. On one datum, girder 1 would rise 28 mm into the 8 in slab on the sheet 52 grade. With the sheet 65 minimum (2 3/16 in from the slab soffit to the underside of the top flange), the 1971 elevations (S7 seats with the S12/S13 stacks, and the S9 top-of-splice table less the sheet 65 dead-load deflections) fit the 2026 deck only if they read 0.05-0.17 ft above the 2026 datum. Sheet 52 existing-deck elevations against the S1 profile suggest about 0.20 ft, which would fit, but no sheet states the relation. Settled by the 2026 screed (top-of-steel) elevations in the Letting Documents "Additional Information" (sheet 59/60 notes) or a survey of the Pier 2 seats and girders.

known_deviations.deviation: With the 2 % deck over the retained girder tops the haunches are 35-102 mm thick above the top flange, and the slab soffit stands 112-141 mm above the underside of the top flange, which meets the sheet 65 section Y-Y minimum of 2 3/16 in (55.6 mm, measured to the underside of the top flange). The haunch profile itself is derived: the field segments sit 1 in (girders 1, 8) / 1/2 in lower than the pier segments, as the S9/S10 splices require, and the girder tops follow the proposed grade less the deck and a nominal haunch.
known_deviations.reason: The haunch is the 2026 deck soffit minus the 2026 top of steel. The plans give the deck (sheets 52, 55, 60), the 2026 concrete dead-load deflections and the minimum haunch (sheet 65). For the steel they give only 1971 data: the S9 top-of-splice elevations (steel dead load only), the S12 no-load camber and the S18 deflections of the old deck. They give neither the 2026 top of steel nor the 1971-to-2026 datum relation, and on one datum the 1971 steel stands above the 2026 soffit (see pier2-shoe-stack). Settled by the 2026 screed elevations ("Additional Information", sheets 59/60) or a survey.

known_deviations.deviation: The transitions are the 1 ft 0 in (0.3048 m) envelope with through windows. Drawn but not modelled: 1 in (25.4 mm) recesses on both faces leaving a 10 in (0.254 m) stem between 4 1/2 in top and bottom bulbs (sections D-D, E-E, F-F, stem height 2 ft 7 1/2 in in D-D); the recess tapering out ("Varies", F-F) over the segment that ends 16 ft 5 1/2 in (5.0165 m, Wings A, B, D) or 15 ft 2 in (4.6228 m, Wing C) from the joint, beyond which section G-G is solid 1 ft 0 in with 3/4 in chamfers (its 3 in - 6 in - 3 in are bar positions); the end-pilaster notches (1 1/2 in). The bridge TX panels are simplified the same way.
known_deviations.reason: Still missing: the recessed panel outline in elevation. Sheets 68/69 do not dimension where the recess starts at the end-bent pilaster, its corner radii, or the recess height at the end of the taper (F-F says only "Varies"), and they refer the TTX details to Standard Drawing E 706-TTTX-01/-02, which is not in the binder. That standard (or dimensioned elevations) would settle it.

known_deviations.deviation: The retained wings are 0.4 m x 5.2 m boxes parallel to the girders, with tops near the bridge seat. S3-S6 dimension splayed wings 31 ft 0 in (9.4488 m) long at Abutment 1 and 23 ft 0 in (7.0104 m) at Abutment 3, with stepped tops rising to El. 727.98 / 728.10 (Wing A, S4) at the abutment, and sheet 70 section C-C draws the wing beside the slab extension up to about the sidewalk. Only the inner face was moved, to 1 in outside the extension (C-C).
known_deviations.reason: The 1971 lengths, splays and top elevations are dimensioned (S3-S6), so the shape is not missing; rebuilding it means four new splayed solids joined to the approximate abutment stems, which this round does not attempt. Still missing for the 2026 state: the wing tops after the mudwall removal (sheet 55 note), which no 2026 sheet dimensions; sheet 70 C-C shows the wing only schematically. Settled by a 2026 wing detail or a survey; deferred to a generator rebuild.

corrections.approach_width: Approach slabs 66 ft 6 in -> 66 ft 2 in and approach walks 6 ft 3 in -> 6 ft 1 in (sheet 66; sheet 70 section C-C), so the slab extensions sit beside them.
corrections.splice-web-plates: Resolved. S9/S10: two 19 in x 5/8 in x 4 ft 6 in web plates, 10 in x 1 in inner splice bars (6 ft 3 in S9, 6 ft 9 in S10), 108 web bolts and 192 (S9) / 208 (S10) flange bolts per splice, 7/8 in (S8); flange splice plates and fillers unchanged.
corrections.lateral_bracing: S11: the 36 lateral envelopes move to the gussets 5 in above the bottom flange, end at the flange tips, and seat on 39 new 3/8 in gusset plates (one per panel point) that run from the web face to the 12 in bolted ends of the tees; clear of the splice bars and bolts.
corrections.tx_end_pilasters: The four bridge TX end pilasters stop 1/4 in short of the deck-end line, giving the full 1/2 in open joint to the transitions (sheets 63, 64, 68, 69).
corrections.wings: Wing inner faces 1 in outside the slab extensions (sheet 70 section C-C), was 80 mm inside.
corrections.pier2_shoe_records: B2 shoe envelopes record the S13 Pier 2 shims and the drawn stacks (metadata only).

decisions.TTX pay limit line: Sheets 68/69 dimension the pay limits on the elevation, not in plan, and the deck-end joint is skewed. Measured along the traffic face from the joint centre line, Wing C (17 ft 2 in) equals the sheet 66 short edge at that line (17 ft 2.0 in in the model) and Wing B (29 ft 4 in) leaves 12 ft 2 in beyond the square end, 1/2 in inside the drawn 12 ft 2 1/2 in extension, as the elevations show; the coping-line reading would overrun the Wing C slab by 6.6 in.
decisions.Approach slab width: Sheet 66 writes 66 ft 2 in (99 spa. @ 8 in + 2 x 3 in) and 68 ft 6 in only with the 1 ft 2 in extensions; the generator's 66 ft 6 in has no source.
decisions.End-bent joint: Sheets 63/64 run the bridge TX pay limits to the end of the bridge floor and sheets 68/69 start the TTX pay limits at the centre line of the 1/2 in open joint, so the joint centre line is the deck-end line: the bridge end pilasters stop 1/4 in short of it and the transitions start 1/4 in beyond it.
decisions.Transition end margins: Sheets 68/69 draw the slab 1/2 in beyond each pay limit. The written pay limits (68/69) and the written extension lengths of sheet 66 (30 ft 10 1/2 in, 12 ft 2 1/2 in, the 17 ft 2 in short edge, 21 ft 1 1/2 in; plan dimensions to the inch) are kept, which leaves margins of 20.5, 13.4, 0.7 and 7.8 mm at Wings A-D. Wing C cannot meet the 1/2 in without moving the sheet 66 square end (54 ft 2 in long edge) or shortening the 17 ft 2 in pay limit; neither sheet governs the other, so both written values are kept.
decisions.Window head: Window detail: R 1 ft 0 in arcs; the head rise is not dimensioned on sheets 68/69 or E 706-BRTX-02 and is scaled from the window detail (1 1/2 in).
decisions.Lateral bracing level: S11 cross frame XF-1 places the 3/8 in gussets at the point of lateral bracing 5 in above the bottom flange, and details C-E end the WT 6 x 18 laterals on them outside the flange tips. The generator had top laterals, which ran into the new splice bars and nuts.

kept.pier2-shoe-stack: The stack itself is drawn: sheet 56 keeps the Pier 2 shoes, S12 gives the shoe heights and S13 the shims. Closing it means raising the girders at Pier 2 by the shortfall, and the plans do not give the 2026 girder elevations that would allow that. On one datum, girder 1 would rise 28 mm into the 8 in slab on the sheet 52 grade. With the sheet 65 minimum (2 3/16 in from the slab soffit to the underside of the top flange), the 1971 elevations (S7 seats with the S12/S13 stacks, and the S9 top-of-splice table less the sheet 65 dead-load deflections) fit the 2026 deck only if they read 0.05-0.17 ft above the 2026 datum. Sheet 52 existing-deck elevations against the S1 profile suggest about 0.20 ft, which would fit, but no sheet states the relation. Settled by the 2026 screed (top-of-steel) elevations in the Letting Documents "Additional Information" (sheet 59/60 notes) or a survey of the Pier 2 seats and girders.
kept.haunch-thickness: The haunch is the 2026 deck soffit minus the 2026 top of steel. The plans give the deck (sheets 52, 55, 60), the 2026 concrete dead-load deflections and the minimum haunch (sheet 65). For the steel they give only 1971 data: the S9 top-of-splice elevations (steel dead load only), the S12 no-load camber and the S18 deflections of the old deck. They give neither the 2026 top of steel nor the 1971-to-2026 datum relation, and on one datum the 1971 steel stands above the 2026 soffit (see pier2-shoe-stack). Settled by the 2026 screed elevations ("Additional Information", sheets 59/60) or a survey.
kept.ttx-face-recesses: Still missing: the recessed panel outline in elevation. Sheets 68/69 do not dimension where the recess starts at the end-bent pilaster, its corner radii, or the recess height at the end of the taper (F-F says only "Varies"), and they refer the TTX details to Standard Drawing E 706-TTTX-01/-02, which is not in the binder. That standard (or dimensioned elevations) would settle it.
kept.retained-wing-envelopes: The 1971 lengths, splays and top elevations are dimensioned (S3-S6), so the shape is not missing; rebuilding it means four new splayed solids joined to the approximate abutment stems, which this round does not attempt. Still missing for the 2026 state: the wing tops after the mudwall removal (sheet 55 note), which no 2026 sheet dimensions; sheet 70 C-C shows the wing only schematically. Settled by a 2026 wing detail or a survey; deferred to a generator rebuild.
